title: Seedreamで画像を生成してからSeedance 2.0で動画化するワークフローを使う

en.content:
Using the workflow of generating images with Seedream and then turning them into videos with Seedance 2.0
Create a video with a three-step acting structure: apply eye drops → shout "It's here!" → say "Welcome to ○○" at your favorite place.

--- QUOTED TWEET ---
#AIOutfitChallenge
It's a common outfit you might find anywhere, but would anyone like to wear it? 😉
Feel free to use the outfit with the tag and quoted post 👍
Outfits in the highlights are also OK 💖 https://t.co/XAJQo7kmzi

Utilizar el flujo de trabajo de generar imágenes con Seedream y luego convertirlas en video con Seedance 2.0  
Aplicarse gotas para los ojos → Gritar "¡Llegó!" → Decir "Bienvenido a ○○" en el lugar que prefieras, en una estructura de actuación de 3 pasos para crear el video
